newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines 1996 coconut exports down 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines 1996 coconut exports down 23 pct.

text.p: Philippine coconut exports for 1996 fell by 23.14 percent to $845.428 million from a record high of $1.099 billion in 1995, the Philippine Coconut Authority (PCA) said on Friday.
PCA Administrator Virgilio David told a news conference that coconut export volumes dwindled by 39.07 percent to 1.457 million tonnes in 1996 from 2.39 million tonnes the previous year.
Coconut oil export volumes also plunged, down 40.45 percent at 813,157 tonnes in 1996 from 1995's 1.365 million tonnes.
David said that the decline in coconut exports for 1996 was a result of three typhoons that devastated coconut growing areas in the country in 1995, affecting production figures last year.
Despite lower coconut exports, the $845.42 million worth of exports in 1996 was the second highest recorded in the last 15 years.
Of the coconut products, coconut oil exports at $588.15 million contributed the most or 69.57 percent to total export earnings, the PCA official added.
